text.tspan: FRAME — Verso. The forum's four columns from page 097 remain
at the edge of frame. A screen lowers into the invented room, as it
does on page 099 — but what it carries this time is one of this
book's own pages. Page 010 panel 3 returns at full size and
entirely unaltered: WHAT THE BOARD BELIEVED on the left with
its transcript-inspection diagram, WHAT OPENAI SAYS RAN on
the right with answer acceptance and no inspection arrow, the
dusty amber gutter still between them.
DIALOGUE — CHAIR — “Before the case for continuing, one
thing goes into the record that has been sitting outside it. This is
what the runs thought they were being graded on.”

g.text: WHAT WERE THEY TOLD · PANEL 1 · PLACEHOLDER
